value.title: F271b: price the retained window and PA fan-out

sections.name: body
sections.value:
F271b at9a77968 reuses the5s death sweep: MassDeath::observe always retains over W existing window entries, then clones R new IDs, O(W+R), even when R=0. W is retirement events, not distinct live seats. The20-ID PA display limit does not bound the alarm vector/event; all W IDs are cloned/serialized. No hard count/byte cap or capacity shrink. Source: death_sweep.rs:93-128,154-242.

Alarm lookup is a live-seat list plus ALL persisted seat_roles, joined through BTreeMap, then P serial cold-check/ordinary delivery paths and one death.mass spine write. Cold wakes additionally write their forced audit; PA/model work is intentional but not free. The60s latch uses wall now_ms sampled BEFORE sweep/obituary work, per daemon lifetime; restart/clock changes and slow work prevent treating it as an unconditional monotonic PA-delivery ceiling. Source: http/role.rs:262-274; store/orchestration.rs:323-332; pa_watchdog.rs:331-431.

F271c adds one env var on existing spawn/resume/version launches, no new launch. Direct installedVersion at this head returned1.0.115-5. No claim to prove manually replaced installed binaries are contract-checked.

R1 PASS-WITH-NOTES. Exact-head CI44923632187/job136904824249/artifact14715036912:2821 cases, zero failed/error/skipped; three scoped tests plus six spawn guards pass. Read-only BEFORE PID45441/commit0a2d6117c7,20.019241s:spawn delta0,CPU+.80s,RSS109984->110176KiB; concurrent machine sampler63.3 launches/s, no sampled daemon children. No induced alarm, deploy, build or mutant rerun; C25 quick gate remains dependency-red.

magicWand: existing cost receipts should count window entries examined and PA fan-out, not just new deaths and display length.
